evals.prompt: Audit the accessibility of our SwiftUI account balance screen (code attached). It has a balance header with custom 13pt fixed font, an icon-only eye button to hide the balance, a parallax header and a chart of the last 30 days.
evals.expected_output: Findings: fixed 13pt font ignores Dynamic Type; icon-only button lacks a label and state value (hidden/shown); parallax needs a Reduce Motion alternative; chart needs an accessible summary or audio graph; balance should read currency correctly; plus a test matrix and fixes with SwiftUI APIs.
assertions: The fixed font size is flagged for Dynamic Type
The eye button gets a label and a state
A Reduce Motion alternative is required for the parallax
The chart gets an accessible alternative
